name: Zoom
subtitle: Netflix-style push, pull and drift on selected clips
description: Adds a slow documentary zoom to every selected clip on the open sequence (video, PNG, JPEG or frame hold). Set the start and end size, an optional drift, and the speed curve (ease in, ease out, or your own); the zoom is keyframed on each clip's Motion Scale and Position, relative to the clip's own size, over its full length. With Live on, every change updates the selected clips straight away. Edge cover shrinks the drift so the frame edge never shows. Reset zoom puts Motion back to the clip's own size and position. Works on up to 12 clips at a time. Cmd+Z also undoes; nothing is saved.
